question: Which matters are to be clearly explained in the procedure of removing the liṅga?
premises: The procedure of removing the liṅga includes hearing and authorization.
It includes purification and removal of sin.
It also includes the cutting away of doubt.
inference: These matters are to be clearly explained in the liṅga-removal procedure.
uncertainties: liṅga here may refer to a ritual emblem or to a subtler mark, depending on context.
plain_english: In the procedure for removing the liṅga, the text will clearly explain hearing, authorization, purification, removal of sin, and the cutting away of doubt.
